By way of filing the present appeal, tthe appellant-injured claimant seeks enhancement of
compensation amount of 2,25,000/- awarded to him vide impugned Award dated 02.05.2016,,
passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ludhiana 02.05.2016, in a claim petition
bearing Mact No. 15 dated 07.05.2012 filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

2.  The matter pertains to the year 2017 and notice of motion in the main appeal as well as in the application filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 was issued by the Predecessor Bench of this Court vide order dated 06.10.2017.

sentences.text: 1 "As nobody was appearing for the appellant, fresh notice ice was ordered to the appellant.
As per report of the Registry, notice has been received back unserved with the report that address is incomplete.
No other address is available on the file of this case.
In view of the same, there is no possibility of compromise promise in this appeal in Lok Adalat.
The same is returned to the Hon'ble High Court for adjudication."

3. On the last date of hearing also i.e. 09.09.2025, the appellant had gone un-represented un before the co-orddinate Bench, and Registry was directed to inform learned counsel for the appellant about the date fixed.
4.

Pursuant thereto, office report dated 02.12.2025 has been received that learned counsel for the appellant has been duly informed about the date fixed through e-mail, e mail, but despite that today again, the appellant has gone un-represented.
5.
In the aforesaid premise, issuance of fresh notice to the appellant would be a futile exercise.
exercise

It appears that due to sheer long pendency of the present appeal before this Court for a period of more than 08 years, the appellant has lost interest in pursuing the same, as no attempt has been made by him to contact hhis counsel or to engage a new counsel.
2 of 3

Be that as it may, in view of the foregoing circumstances, the instant appeal is disposed of, with liberty to the appellant, to move ove an appropriate application within a period of 06 weeks from today for reviving the same, if so, advised.
7. Pending application(s), if any, shall stands disposed of.
